en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a busy seafront quay with moored boats and small ships along the waterfront. A cobbled promenade runs beside the water with pedestrians, horse-drawn carriages, and a tram or wagon. Multi‑storey waterfront buildings line the right side. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the scene as the quay of the Messageries Maritimes in Salonique (Thessaloniki).
